name: Carcavelos
description: Sandy beach break, consistent and beginner-friendly with small to medium waves.

name: Praia do Guincho
description: Exposed beach with strong winds and powerful waves. Can get challenging.

name: Costa da Caparica
description: Long sandy coastline with many peaks. Good for beginners and intermediates.

name: Praia Grande (Sintra)
description: Powerful beach break with consistent swell. Can get big and heavy.

name: São Julião
description: Less crowded spot with good sandbanks. Works well with west swells.

name: The Cave
description: Less crowded slab with barrels. Ideal for advance or professional surfers.
